ambiguities.text: The specification emphasizes 'readability and simplicity' over optimization without defining measurable criteria for either.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this means implementations should prefer straightforward code paths and avoid premature optimization. This is a stylistic guideline, not a formal constraint.

ambiguities.text: The distinction between 'configurations' (network-specific) and 'presets' (testing-specific) is stated but the boundary cases are not defined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume configurations are values that differ between mainnet and testnets (e.g., genesis time), while presets are values that only differ in test environments (e.g., reduced committee sizes).

implicit_assumptions.description: The specification assumes all feature authors have sufficient understanding of the fork transition mechanism to correctly implement state initialization.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect state initialization could lead to consensus failures at fork boundaries, potentially causing chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: The CI pipeline is assumed to provide comprehensive test coverage sufficient to catch specification errors before deployment.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Specification bugs could pass CI and be deployed to production networks, potentially causing consensus failures.
